outcomes.name: Ten songs and five canonical characters exist
Start, brief, movement and diagonal normalization
Keyboard cannot cross furniture or map boundaries
Touch paths avoid all colliders and find every pickup
An item is only scored once
The stage refuses incomplete equipment
Pause freezes movement, clock, health and notes
Time limit causes defeat and retry resets everything
Moving puddles inflict damage with immunity between collisions
Perfect notes score and combos increase rewards
Good timing is accepted inside the calm hit window
Wrong lanes and expired notes reset the combo
Missing a song causes defeat
Health depletion causes defeat
All ten songs are completed in order in BOTH difficulties
Retry after success does not duplicate the campaign score
Stars and unlocks save and reload
Broken or hostile saves are sanitized
Unavailable storage does not stop play
A blocked destination returns safely without trapping the player
